verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report says LanceDB is an embeddable vector database and that the user ran it inside an Electron application. The storage docs say it runs on local NVMe, which supports a lightweight local setup. However, no first-party doc in the pack explicitly describes an embedded in-process mode or a local connect workflow. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of embedded/in-process usage (e.g., local path connect), explicit guidance for development and small-workload local deployment, and broader independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the database embedded in-process or as a lightweight local instance for development and small workloads

citations.quote: LanceDB is one of the few options for embeddable vector databases, and I have used it in my Electron application.
That design makes it flexible enough to run across local NVMe, EBS, EFS, and any object store that exposes an S3-compatible API.
